claims.claim: The EU AI Act introduces stricter obligations for high-risk AI systems.

sources.name: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act)
supports: Sets risk-tiered obligations, including requirements for high-risk AI systems.
limits: Legal text alone does not prove implementation quality by regulated firms.

sources.name: European Commission AI Act policy page
supports: Summarizes the EU regulatory framework and implementation approach for the AI Act.
limits: Overview page may lag detailed implementing acts and guidance.

sources.name: European Commission AI Act Service Desk announcement
supports: Shows official support activity for businesses preparing for AI Act compliance.
limits: Support service activity is not direct evidence of enterprise compliance maturity.

unsupported_claims: Exact sector-by-sector enforcement outcomes cannot be inferred from the legal text alone.
source_plan: Check final EU AI Act legal text on EUR-Lex
Check European Commission implementation and guidance pages
Check official business-support and procurement/compliance signals
